custom_css: @media (max-width: 589px) {.freq__item {display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; margin-bottom: 5px; } .freq__item :is(label, a) {line-height: 1.2; } .freq__item-price {display: block; padding: 0; } .freq__item:first-child .freq__item-price {display: inline; padding-left: 10px; } .freq__add {font-size: 16px; padding: 11px 20px; }}
@media (min-width: 590px) {.grid {/* Centre incomplete rows */ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }}
.grid-product,.grid-product__link,.grid-product__meta {/* Stack product-card content */ display: flex; flex-direction: column;}
.grid-product__price {/* Align prices and buttons */ margin-top: auto;}
